Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel analytic rules carried by this solution (ContentKind AnalyticsRule and its AnalyticsRuleTemplate registration face).
Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel workbook content and its Content Hub registration carried by this solution (ContentKind Workbook and WorkbookTemplate).

properties.description: CiscoSEGDLPViolation_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.2.2

properties.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Outgoing'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESADLPVerdict'
| extend dlp_verdict = extract(@'ESADLPVerdict":"(NOT_EVALUATED|NO TRIGGER|VIOLATION|NO VIOLATION)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where dlp_verdict =~ 'VIOLATION'
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SrcUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

properties.description: Detects mails with malicious attachments which were not blocked.
properties.displayName: Cisco SEG - Malicious attachment not blocked
properties.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where SimplifiedDeviceAction =~ 'DELIVERED'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAAMPVerdict'
| extend amp_verdict = extract(@'ESAAMPVerdict":"(NOT_EVALUATED|CLEAN|FA_PENDING|UNKNOWN|SKIPPED|UNSCANNABLE|LOW_RISK|MALICIOUS)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where amp_verdict =~ 'MALICIOUS'
| extend AccountCustomEntity = DstUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

properties.displayName: Cisco SEG - Malicious attachment not blocked
Cisco SEG - Multiple large emails sent to external recipient
properties.query:
let e_theshold = 3;
let s_threshold = 10000000;
CiscoSEGEvent
| where AdditionalFields[15]['ESAMsgSize'] > s_threshold
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Outgoing'
| extend rec_domain = extract(@'@(.*)', 1, DstUserName)
| extend s_domain = extract(@'@(.*)', 1, SrcUserName)
| where s_domain != rec_domain
| summarize count(), TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), SourceIP = take_any(SourceIP), DvcIpAddr = take_any(DvcIpAddr) by SrcUserName
| where count_ >= e_theshold
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SrcUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)

properties.displayName: Cisco SEG - Multiple large emails sent to external recipient
Cisco SEG - Multiple suspiciuos attachments received
properties.query:
let r_threshold = 5;
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where isnotempty(EventMessage)
| where strlen(EventMessage) < 20
| summarize rec = make_set(DstUserName), TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), SrcUserName = take_any(SrcUserName), SourceIP = take_any(SourceIP), DvcIpAddr = take_any(DvcIpAddr) by EventMessage, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where array_length(rec) > r_threshold
| extend AccountCustomEntity = tostring(rec[0]), IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr), rec = strcat_array(rec, ', ')

properties.displayName: Cisco SEG - Multiple suspiciuos attachments received

properties.description: CiscoSEGPossibleOutbreak_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.2.2

properties.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAOFVerdict'
| extend of_verdict = extract(@'ESAOFVerdict":"(NOT_EVALUATED|POSITIVE|NEGATIVE)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where of_verdict =~ 'POSITIVE'
| extend AccountCustomEntity = DstUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

let dl_cat = dynamic(['Illegal Downloads']);
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAURLDetails'
| extend link_cat = extract(@"'Category': '(.*?)'", 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where link_cat in~ (dl_cat)
| extend AccountCustomEntity = DstUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

properties.description: CiscoSEGSuspiciousLink_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.2.2

properties.query:
let bl_cat = dynamic(['Adult', 'Hacking', 'Cheating and Plagiarism', 'Child Abuse Content', 'Dating', 'Illegal Activities', 'Pornography']);
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAURLDetails'
| extend link_cat = extract(@"'Category': '(.*?)'", 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where link_cat in~ (bl_cat)
| extend AccountCustomEntity = DstUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| extend rec_domain = extract(@'@(.*)', 1, DstUserName)
| extend s_domain = extract(@'@(.*)', 1, SrcUserName)
| where s_domain != rec_domain
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESASDRDomainAge'
| extend domain_age = extract(@'ESASDRDomainAge":"(.*days)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| extend yy = toint(extract(@'(\d+)\syears', 1, domain_age))
| extend mm = toint(extract(@'(\d+)\smonths', 1, domain_age))
| extend dd = toint(extract(@'(\d+)\sdays', 1, domain_age))
| where isempty(yy)
| where isempty(mm) or mm <= 2
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SrcUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

properties.description: CiscoSEGUnclassifiedLink_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.2.2

properties.query:
let u_cat = dynamic(['Unclassified']);
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAURLDetails'
| extend link_cat = extract(@"'Category': '(.*?)'", 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where link_cat in~ (u_cat)
| extend AccountCustomEntity = DstUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAAttachmentDetails'
| extend attachment = replace_string(tostring(extract(@'"ESAAttachmentDetails":"{(.*?):', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))), "'", "")
| where attachment endswith '.ps1' or attachment endswith '.lnk' or attachment endswith '.exe'
| extend AccountCustomEntity = DstUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAAMPVerdict'
| extend amp_verdict = extract(@'ESAAMPVerdict":"(NOT_EVALUATED|CLEAN|FA_PENDING|UNKNOWN|SKIPPED|UNSCANNABLE|LOW_RISK|MALICIOUS)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where amp_verdict =~ 'UNSCANNABLE'
| extend AccountCustomEntity = DstUserName, IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP, DvcIpAddr)
| project-away AdditionalFields

properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceEventClassID =~ 'ESA_CONSOLIDATED_LOG_EVENT'
| parse-kv AdditionalExtensions as (startTime:string, endTime:string, ESAAttachmentDetails:string) with (pair_delimiter=';', kv_delimiter='=')
| parse-kv AdditionalExtensions as (ESAMID:int, ESAICID:int, ESADCID:int, ESAAMPVerdict:string, ESAASVerdict:string, ESAAVVerdict:string, ESACFVerdict:string, ESADLPVerdict:string, ESADMARCVerdict:string, ESAFriendlyFrom:string, ESAGMVerdict:string, ESAMailFlowPolicy:string, ESAMFVerdict:string, ESAOFVerdict:string, ESAHeloDomain:string, ESAReplyTo:string, ESASDRDomainAge:string, ESASPFVerdict:string, sourceHostName:string, sourceAddress:string, ESATLSInConnStatus:string, ESATLSInProtocol:string, ESATLSOutConnStatus:string, AdditionalFields:dynamic) with (pair_delimiter=';', kv_delimiter='=')

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) solution provides the capability to ingest Cisco SEG Consolidated Event Logs into Microsoft Sentinel.

This solution is dependent on the Common Event Format solution containing the CEF via AMA connector to collect the logs. The CEF solution will be installed as part of this solution installation.

NOTE: Microsoft recommends installation of CEF via AMA Connector. The existing connectors are about to be deprecated by Aug 31, 2024.

Parsers: 1, Workbooks: 1, Analytic Rules: 11, XDR Detections: 11, Hunting Queries: 10, XDR Workbooks: 1

parameters.name: TimeRange
parameters.description: Sets the time name for analysis

content.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| make-series TotalEvents = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain};
content.title: Events Over Time

content.query:
let tot_m = CiscoSEGEvent
| summarize e_count=count()
| extend Title='Total Mails';
let rec = CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where SimplifiedDeviceAction =~ 'DELIVERED'
| summarize e_count=count()
| extend Title='Mails Delivered';
let q_m = CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where SimplifiedDeviceAction =~ 'QUARANTINED'
| summarize e_count=count()
| extend Title='Quarantined Mails';
let mal_m = CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAAMPVerdict'
| extend amp_verdict = extract(@'ESAAMPVerdict":"(NOT_EVALUATED|CLEAN|FA_PENDING|UNKNOWN|SKIPPED|UNSCANNABLE|LOW_RISK|MALICIOUS)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where amp_verdict =~ 'MALICIOUS'
| summarize e_count=count()
| extend Title='Malicious Mails';
union isfuzzy=true tot_m, rec, q_m, mal_m
| order by e_count
content.title: Mail Summary

content.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| summarize tot_m = count() by DstUserName
| join kind = inner (CiscoSEGEvent
 | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain} by DstUserName)
 on DstUserName
| project-away DstUserName1, TimeGenerated
| project User = DstUserName, TotalMailsReceived=tot_m, Trend
| order by TotalMailsReceived
| take 6
content.title: Users' mail volume

content.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Outgoing'
| where isnotempty(SrcUserName)
| summarize count() by SrcUserName
| top 10 by count_
content.title: Top Senders

content.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where isnotempty(DstUserName)
| summarize count() by DstUserName
| top 10 by count_
content.title: Top Recipients

content.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where SimplifiedDeviceAction =~ 'DELIVERED'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAAMPVerdict'
| extend amp_verdict = extract(@'ESAAMPVerdict":"(NOT_EVALUATED|CLEAN|FA_PENDING|UNKNOWN|SKIPPED|UNSCANNABLE|LOW_RISK|MALICIOUS)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where amp_verdict =~ 'UNSCANNABLE'
| extend Filename = replace_string(tostring(extract(@'"ESAAttachmentDetails":"{(.*?):', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))), "'", "")
| order by TimeGenerated
| project TimeGenerated, DstUserName, Filename
content.title: Unscannable Files

content.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
| where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
| where SimplifiedDeviceAction =~ 'DELIVERED'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESAAMPVerdict'
| extend amp_verdict = extract(@'ESAAMPVerdict":"(NOT_EVALUATED|CLEAN|FA_PENDING|UNKNOWN|SKIPPED|UNSCANNABLE|LOW_RISK|MALICIOUS)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
| where amp_verdict =~ 'MALICIOUS'
| extend Filename = replace_string(tostring(extract(@'"ESAAttachmentDetails":"{(.*?):', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))), "'", "")
| summarize count() by Filename
content.title: Top Malicious Attachments

content.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
  | where NetworkDirection =~ 'Outgoing'
  | where tostring(AdditionalFields) has 'ESADLPVerdict'
  | extend dlp_verdict = extract(@'ESADLPVerdict":"(NOT_EVALUATED|NO TRIGGER|VIOLATION|NO VIOLATION)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
  | where dlp_verdict =~ 'VIOLATION'
  | extend File = replace_string(tostring(extract(@'"ESAAttachmentDetails":"{(.*?):', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))), "'", "")
  | project TimeGenerated, SrcUserName, DstUserName, File
content.title: Users with DLP Violation

content.query:
CiscoSEGEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
  | where NetworkDirection =~ 'Incoming'
  | extend act_det = extract(@'ESAFinalActionDetails":"(.*?)"', 1, tostring(AdditionalFields))
  | where act_det has 'To SPAM'
  | summarize count() by SrcUserName
  | top 10 by count_
content.title: SPAM Sources
